cases.scenario: Cache listing:<id> shared across viewers: owner GET of pending_approval then guest GET must not leak
cases.preconditions: pending_approval fixture cmw9clny500j3u4pwwnlj09tb owned by ST_USER; owner token available; no prior guest request needed; run owner first then anon
cases.test_data: id=cmw9clny500j3u4pwwnlj09tb; step1 role user(owner), step2 role anon (mixed-role ordered sequence)
cases.steps: 1) GET /listings/cmw9clny500j3u4pwwnlj09tb as owner  2) immediately GET /listings/cmw9clny500j3u4pwwnlj09tb with no Authorization
cases.req_headers: Step1: Authorization: Bearer <ST_USER token>; Step2: none
cases.response_assertions: Step1 body.listingStatus == 'pending_approval'; Step2 body.message == 'Listing not found' and no listing fields in body
cases.business_outcome: The DTO is cached under a shared key (listings.service.ts:770-778); the gate must be re-applied per viewer so a cached owner read never leaks a pending_approval listing to a guest
cases.expected: Owner GET 200, then anonymous GET 404 (no leak via cache)
cases.source: Blind inventory #22 / review finding #3 | QA suggestion (audit Test design inputs c/f: cache shared across viewers; re-gate test listings.service.spec.ts:999-1007)

cases.scenario: Malformed (garbage) Bearer token on an approved listing is treated as guest: 200, no 401
cases.preconditions: approved fixture cmw9clqi900j6u4pwojktukum; harness cannot inject an arbitrary garbage token (roles are only anon/user/admin) so run manually
cases.steps: GET /listings/cmw9clqi900j6u4pwojktukum with header Authorization: Bearer not.a.jwt
cases.business_outcome: OptionalJwtAuthGuard never rejects (optional-jwt-auth.guard.ts:13-17); invalid token degrades to guest
cases.source: Audit scenario #16 / review finding #11 | QA suggestion (code behaviour optional-jwt-auth.guard.ts:14-16; no requirement source)

cases.scenario: Malformed Bearer token on a pending_approval listing is treated as guest: 404, never 401 and never the listing
cases.preconditions: pending_approval fixture cmw9clny500j3u4pwwnlj09tb; harness cannot send a garbage token
cases.steps: GET /listings/cmw9clny500j3u4pwwnlj09tb with header Authorization: Bearer not.a.jwt
cases.response_assertions: body.message == 'Listing not found'; no listing fields; not 401/403/5xx
cases.business_outcome: Invalid token is guest, so the pending_approval gate must still hide the listing
cases.source: Audit scenario #16 / review finding #11 | QA suggestion (code behaviour optional-jwt-auth.guard.ts:14-16, listings.service.ts:786; no requirement source)

cases.scenario: Anonymous response of an approved listing exposes no private seller fields (email, phone, etc.)
cases.response_assertions: body.seller exists; body.seller.email absent; body.seller.phone absent; body.seller.passwordHash absent; body.sellerEmail absent
cases.business_outcome: Seller block must expose only the public mapSeller fields (id, username, displayName, avatarUrl, rating, ratingCount, salesCount, followersCount, location, lastActiveAt)
cases.expected: 200; seller block has no email/phone/password fields
cases.source: Blind inventory #25 / review finding #12 | QA suggestion (public seller field list from audit Declared Contract, listings.service.ts:215-232; privacy expectation not in a requirement source)
